skip.url-state: the page keeps no state in the URL; it keeps the session in localStorage, which the keyboard check reloads to verify
skip.back-forward: the page pushes no history entries, so Back and Forward have nothing to restore (its own Back button is covered by the keyboard check)
skip.command-palette: the page has no command palette
skip.json-round-trip: the page has no JSON state file; it exports the answered session as TOON, which the keyboard check saves and reads, and by design it refuses to re-import an exported session
skip.beamdswitch-export: the page exports no beamdswitch deck
skip.reset: not applicable: the page has no Reset because answers are immutable by design (the first answer is never overwritten); starting a new session over an unfinished one, with its replace guard, is covered at the end of the keyboard check

findings.evidence: no Copy Markdown control: the page keeps an answered session but exports it only as TOON, with no Markdown of the session state
